label: Arduino IDE: Search Library
command: $zoek = Read-Host "Welke library zoek je?"; if ($zoek) { arduino-cli lib search "$zoek" }

label: Arduino IDE: Install Library (Handmatig)
command: $lib = Read-Host "Welke library wil je installeren?"; if ($lib) { arduino-cli lib install "$lib" }

label: Arduino IDE: Auto-Install Libraries
command: $file = Get-ChildItem "${ZED_DIRNAME}" -Filter "*.ino" | Select-Object -First 1; if ($file) { $includes = Get-Content $file.FullName | Where-Object { $_ -match "#include" } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Substring(8).Trim().Trim("<>").Trim([char]34) }; $includes | ForEach-Object { $cleanLib = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($_).Replace("_", " "); if ($cleanLib -notmatch "Arduino|SPI|Wire|SoftwareSerial|EEPROM") { Write-Host "Systeem probeert te installeren: $cleanLib"; arduino-cli lib install "$cleanLib" } } } else { Write-Host "Geen .ino bestand gevonden" }
